notes.title: Statement of Purifications from the Sanctuary
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, friends from the otherworld![/h3]
We want to announce that we was completed an update on the August 27 2021.
The contents are as stated below.


[h3][b]Elf Costumes[/b][/h3]
・Added 2 Default costume.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40595499/1a3ffa989c2cd1b6ce105ee5d5f455eb39b5cca4.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]難易度[/b][/h3]
・Adjusted the appearance frequency of dragons on the cliff stage.

[h3][b]改善[/b][/h3]
・Addition of a function that allows you to check the reward list from the menu.


[h3][b]Addition of a function that allows you to view the reward list from the menu[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]For Future Updates[/b][/h3]
・Added single-player stage.
・Added multiplayer stage.
・Added elf race.
・Added elf costume.
・Added multiplayer avatar.


[h3]Thank you for your continuous support![/h3]

notes.title: Statement of Purifications from the Sanctuary
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, friends from the otherworld![/h3]
We want to announce that we was completed an update on the July 16, 2021.
The contents are as stated below.


[h3][b]Elf Costumes[/b][/h3]
・Added 2 default costume.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40595499/8732f6a440bdffac54babca8174724122929c3c7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40595499/2a40d7fbb0b2f504513238bf42fc227907e93631.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]Cut Scenes[/b][/h3]
・Added skip function.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40595499/03fb3eaf035af64b5ef425d8d637f2b18a6d6edb.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]Difficulty[/b][/h3]
・Adjusted all creatures weakness target size.
・Adjusted the damage of some creatures.


[h3][b]Background[/b][/h3]
・Adjusted the degree of purifications.
・Reduced grass models on all stages.


[h3][b]Improvement[/b][/h3]
・Add trajectory function.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40595499/c8b35757c6321cd487a528ccf30a0d395384ce12.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40595499/ea24b1c37b4ffc3510113b4e46fb6261788c12b4.jpg[/img]

・Fix the pause UI so it will appears after moving.

・Changed WAVE notification.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40595499/d0d717e66081e8748a385a617e7a1d0fecf307c8.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]Bug[/b][/h3]
・Fixed save timing.
・Fixed Elf default facial expression. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40595499/c104b8e1bdc1e3798f6bdcf4945ec7081bb0c6fc.png[/img]

[h3][b]Scheduled to be updated next month.[/b][/h3]
・Added  special goblin to「Ancient Forest」.
・Added  special merman to「Canyon of Life」.
・Added 2 default costume.
・Improved UI

[h3][b]For Future Updates[/b][/h3]
・Added single-player stage.
・Added multiplayer stage.
・Added elf race.
・Added elf costume.
・Added multiplayer avatar.


[h3]Thank you for your continuous support![/h3]
